WHAT I THINK:
I am absolutely buzzing with excitement! The idea that I can build a little digital home for myself just by typing out some instructions is like magic, and I love that I get to pick the colors.

INTEREST LEVEL:
10/10 because I love the idea of creating something that others can actually visit and see on their own screens.

WHAT CAUGHT MY ATTENTION:
That little bit of JavaScript that makes a button say "Quack!" when you click it is brilliant; I need that on every page I build.

HOW IT CONNECTS TO WHAT I KNOW:
It fits perfectly with my goal to make cool things, and it makes my earlier interest in building a tiny game feel totally possible since I have the building blocks now.
